against.text: Price is below a falling 30-week average: the declining stage.

material.head: Sitting on stacked support
material.text: Price sits on the 50-day average, the average price paid since the Oct 22 high and the 50% retracement of the Oct 22–Oct 28 drop, where 8 levels (3 kinds) meet.
material.learn: Different kinds of support at one price (a swing low, an average, a retracement) make a stronger floor than any one alone.

material.head: Weekly: wave 2 turning up from its zone
material.text: Five clean waves up from Oct 22, 2024 to Jan 15 (+214%, wave 1). The pullback turned up from the 0.618–0.786 zone of that advance (−0.6% to −20%), with the Oct 9, 2023 low in the same place. The count is wrong under the start of wave 1 (−45%); a close over the wave-1 high (+72%) says wave 3 is under way.
material.learn: After five waves up the pullback usually ends between the 0.618 and 0.786 retracement of the advance; a close turning up there is the buy.

material.head: Selling is losing force (weekly)
material.text: Weekly: a lower low in price (the week of Oct 26) against a higher low in momentum (5 of 7 gauges): regular bullish divergence.
material.learn: Lower price lows with rising momentum lows: sellers are tiring.

material.head: Holding its rising 50-day
material.text: It dipped to its rising 50-day average in the last three sessions and held above it.
material.learn: The average close of the last 20, 50 or 200 sessions; rising averages mark uptrends and often act as support.

material.head: Next support −3.8% below
material.text: The next floor under it is −3.8% below (0.6 ATR), where 5 levels (3 kinds) meet: the Sep 15 low, the most-traded price of six months and the 61.8% retracement of the Oct 28–Nov 12 rise.
material.learn: A price where buyers stepped in before.

material.head: Weekly: wave 4 in its buy zone
material.text: Waves 1 to 3 up from Aug 4, 2025 to May 7 (+166%; wave 3 is 3.8 times wave 1). The pullback has reached the 0.382–0.5 zone of wave 3 (+8.3% to −0.7%), on lighter volume, with the 50-week average and the Aug 10 low in the same place. The count is wrong on a close under the wave-1 high (−28%): wave 4 never overlaps wave 1.
material.learn: Wave 4 usually pulls back to the 0.382–0.5 retracement of wave 3 and holds above wave 1's top; the buy comes when price turns up there.
